entries.title: Amos 9:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
buildeth. Ps 104:3,13 stories. or, spheres. Heb. ascensions.{M��loth,} "upper chambers," which in eastern houses are the principal apartments. Perhaps there is a reference here to the various systems which God has created in illimitable space, transcending each other as the planets do in our system.

troop. or, bundle. Ge 2:1 {Aguddah} probably is the same as the Arabic {ijad,} "an arch, vault," and may here denote the vault of heaven, or atmosphere, which God "hath founded, or established, upon, or over, {�l,} the earth," and into which "he calleth the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth."
